transcript.text: my washin mashine wont turn on at all no lights nothin

If your washing machine has absolutely no lights and makes no noise at all, it usually means it isn't getting electricity from the mains. The most common reasons are a tripped fuse in the plug, a loose connection, or simply that the wall socket itself has lost power. Please try this simple check first: plug a lamp or your phone charger into that same wall socket to see if it works. Let me know what happens.
other sockets in the kitchen work, my kettle works fine. the washing machine is built in behind a cupboard door tho so i cant see the socket

Since the socket is hidden behind the cupboard, we can't easily test if power is reaching it. However, since other kitchen sockets work, the issue is likely at the plug end or the cable itself. Please unplug the machine and check:
1. Is there a fuse in the plug? If you can see through the fuse holder, is the wire inside broken or blackened?
2. Are the pins loose in the socket, or does the cable feel damaged near the plug? If the fuse is blown, replace it with one of the same rating (usually 13A). If the fuse is fine but the machine still won't turn on, we may need to check if the mains lead itself has failed internally.
i cant reach the plug, its behind the machine and i cant pull it out cos its built in and im not allowed to take the cupboard off. i dont have any tools either. what else can i check?

The fact that other sockets work suggests the problem is either the machine's own plug fuse or an internal electrical fault (like a failed power switch or PCB). Because you cannot access the plug to check a potential blown fuse, and opening the machine requires tools and safety precautions, I recommend calling an engineer. They can safely test the mains input and diagnose whether it needs a simple part replacement or more complex repair.

candidates: No power from the wall socket or plug connection (high)
Faulty mains lead or internal fuse/filter (medium)
Failed main control PCB (power supply section) (low)
